spec_case: issue #778: every CEL site accepts an expression exactly at the explicit nesting limit
description: An `if`, a `while` loop (`max_iterations: 1`), a tool's `expect:` and a `cel` tool each hold one expression at exactly MAX_CEL_NESTING_DEPTH (32) -- a different nesting shape per site (a member-access chain, an `&&` run, a grouping-parenthesis chain, and a list-literal chain) -- and the whole document compiles and runs to completion on both engines.
